integrity: The degree-four generic-orbit premise is taken from the full motivating preprint; the group action, residue-form invariance, function-field equality, and quotient-resolution argument were reconstructed independently. A finite verifier checks all 15 coordinate pairings and the pair-sign invariances but is not used as a substitute for the geometric proof.
scientific limitations: The theorem identifies minimal resolutions of the explicit dodecic images with Klein-four symplectic quotient resolutions. It does not compute quotient Neron--Severi lattices or claim an integral full-Hodge-structure classification.
title: Uniform Klein-four quotient description for all magic octic--dodecic K3 maps
